# cycle_pipeline (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle pipeline by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a pipeline by ID.
data "cycle_pipeline" "deploy" {
  id = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

output "pipeline_state" {
  value = data.cycle_pipeline.deploy.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the pipeline.

### Read-Only

- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline is disabled and cannot be triggered.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Whether variable interpolation and other advanced logic is enabled on this pipeline.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this pipeline belongs to.
- `identifier` (String) The human-readable slugged identifier of the pipeline.
- `name` (String) The user-defined name of the pipeline.
- `stages` (String) The pipeline stages as normalized JSON. Null when the pipeline has no stages.
- `state` (String) The current state of the pipeline.
